AnalysisMetaAccess.optionalLookupJavaType queries AnalysisUniverse.optionalLookup without creating an analysis type. registerAsImmutable creates a structural ImageHeapConstant and records immutability, without markReachable or markTypeInstantiated. Therefore an isInstantiated guard is not required by this API. An independent registerAsUsed-only feature with ForeignAPISupport disabled builds and runs successfully.

isForeignAPIEnabled defaults to true except LLVM; explicit false disables ForeignFunctionsFeature. The candidate guards actual reachability rather than the flag, preserving support whenever consumers make the singleton reachable. Explicit true hello and default-FFM runtime unregistered upcall/downcall roundtrip succeeded.

The four-line hello-world gate addition is small and targets the failing beforeCompilation path. The hello source needs no runtime-loaded class: the defect occurs during image creation. Appended extra-image-builder arguments can override the regression options, matching existing gate conventions; no concrete failing configured gate found.
